title: Meh
text: Meh. It's ok, I guess. Nothing spectacular. Super thin. Some texture on slick fabric. Fits on table perfectly. It was incredibly hard to find a tablecloth that would fit my table. Wasn't even about price anymore. That's the plus. More expensive than I preferred. Especially for how things it is. I just want thick plain black. Nothing fancy. Silvery sage green was the best I could do. Bruh

description: Impress your guests with this elegant spillproof tablecloth. This tablecloth is perfect for everyday use, and will bring elegance to your dining table. Perfect tablecloth for casual dining or even messy dinners! All liquids and spills will bead up for an easy clean. Made of a special treated polyester fabric material that is extremely easy to clean. Machine washable. This tablecloth washes very well and will be ready to use for many additional uses.
